title: QuickSort (With Code in Python/C++/Java/C) - Programiz
snippet: Quicksort selects a pivot element and partitions the other elements into two sub-arrays according to whether they are less than or greater than the pivot, then recursively sorts the sub-arrays. Average time complexity is O(n log n); worst case is O(n^2) when the pivot is the highest or lowest value.

title: DSA Quicksort with Python - W3Schools
snippet: The most commonly used partitioning approach is the Lomuto partition scheme, where the last element of the array is chosen as the pivot.
